question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Economies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, it discusses a sustained long-term downturn in economic activity.
 
• The word "economic activity" refers to the economic performance or condition of a particular region or country.
 
• To make the sentence grammatically correct and coherent, the word to fill in the blank should be "**economies**" because it accurately conveys that depression refers to a downturn in economic activity in one or more regions or countries.
 
• The correct word "**economies**" refers to the system of production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services in a particular region or country. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र या देश में वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के उत्पादन, वितरण और उपभोग की प्रणाली)

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Services**" refer to the work done by one person or group that benefits another. (एक व्यक्ति या समूह द्वारा किया गया वह कार्य जिससे दूसरे व्यक्ति या समूह को लाभ होता है)
 
• "**Autonomies**" refers to the state of being self-governed or having independence. (स्वशासित या स्वतंत्र होने की अवस्था या भाव)
 
• "**Astronomies**" refers to the study of celestial objects and phenomena. (आकाशीय पिंडों और घटनाओं का अध्ययन)
